blockNote: Erasquez in the Euro geezer house (scene $92): the Teapot test and the hint that sets flag $9F.

Solid and interactable. The interact handler tests the inventory first (BranchIfHasItem #19). With the Teapot (item $19) he prints 'Erasquez: I feel the presence of evil from somewhere in town...' and changes nothing (the item stays, $9F is not touched). Without the Teapot and $9F clear he sets $9F and prints 'Hey, you! I feel a strange power coming from you...' ending with 'At the right time, go to Mt.Kress and take a look at the Teapot.' and 'Rofsky marked Mt.Kress on Will's map!'. Without the Teapot and $9F set he prints 'The spirits' tears in the teapot reflect your true form.'. $9F is read by the Euro world-map exit (scene $91), which then stages menu $10 (Quit / Mt.Temple / Watermia) instead of menu $0F; flag $AC takes precedence with menu $1A.
Neil's father at the Rolek mansion (scene $95): a Moon Tribe reveal triggered by the Teapot.

$A8 set: the actor dies at spawn. Otherwise it stands solid with 'You can't go wrong by taking over the Rolek Company.' and waits for $A8 (set by UseItem_Teapot when the Teapot is used in tiles (28,09)-(2D,0D) of this scene). Then it locks the player ($EFFC, joypadMaskStd reads $EFF0), waits 4 ticks (WaitByte #03), starts music #1B, waits (WaitByte #3B), clears its solidity, walks, prints 'Moon Tribe: Ku ku ku... Soon this world will be wrapped in darkness. The previous owner of this body is now a skeleton sleeping under the shrine...', walks toward (0268,0060), starts music #04, waits 120 ticks (WaitByte #77), unlocks the player and falls through into code_07E21A (COP Die). Neil's mother runs the same walk and dies earlier in the same visit.
Neil's mother at the Rolek mansion (scene $95).

$A8 set: the actor dies at spawn. Otherwise it stands solid with 'We've made money and wish to spend our remaining years enjoying life. Why don't you succeed us...' and waits for $A8 (the Teapot use); then it clears its solidity, walks off, moves toward (0268,0060), the same target as Neil's father, and dies when the walk ends (the actor definition falls through into code_07E314, COP Die).
